category_edits.rationale: Add a 0.1-weighted uniform pairwise auxiliary loss to the existing hardness-weighted objective using the same valid positive and negative scores. This may improve ranking while preserving sampling, architecture, inference, optimizer, and training schedule.

pairwise_loss = torch.nn.functional.softplus(valid_neg - valid_pos)
